title: Semantic architecture and inhabited street edges
description: Procedural OSM-tag-based facades: shops/cafes, homes/apartments, civic/school/church, medical and workshop entrances. Named signage, porches, balconies, shop windows, seating, planters and loading areas. Street-facing placement uses nearest actual road segment. Batches facade geometry. Fictional designs, no imagery or building interiors.
author: the internet slop warehouse

author: the internet slop warehouse
title: Inhabited streets: OSM scene renderer
description: Three.js environment from normalized OSM geometry: extruded footprints and courtyard holes, mapped or inferred heights, home roofs, shared brick maps, deterministic lit windows, semantic building palettes, road ribbons, water, streetlights, water towers, procedural infill vegetation, clue markers and colored player avatars with light cones. Façades and vegetation are inferred; no street imagery. Original code CC0, underlying maps ODbL. Fork with non-casting ground/road layers to avoid overlapping surface shadow artifacts, plus anisotropic road texture sampling. Inject semantic-architecture classification and finish hooks.
